Cabbage & Kidney Bean Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 11:16pm

Ingredients




1 teaspoon chopped onion
1/2 teaspoon chopped parsley
1/2 teaspoon chopped garlic
1/4 head cabbage, shredded
1 stalk celery, chopped
1 sweet pickle, chopped
3 tablespoons kidney beans

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients well and cover with the following dressing: 1 tbsp. wine vinegar 1 1/2 tsp. sugar 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. seasoning salt Dash of pepper 2 Marinate salad in dressing and chill. Serves 2.
